🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector strength (Financials +4.14% and Healthcare +1.75% vs Technology only +1.30%) and major divergence across large-cap Tech (multiple 1W up / 1M down); Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Financials leading: SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing early pickup: XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -6.81%) RECOVERY, CVX (1W: +3.29% | 1M: -7.61%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Real Estate weak: EQIX (1W: -5.74% | 1M: -6.08%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary weak: RCL (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND; Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -9.40%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +16.14% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +13.95% | 1M: -20.53%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.76% | 1M: -7.23%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -20.17% | 1M: +10.52%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -9.01% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Semiconductors/Tech and select Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Big 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +16.14% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +13.95% | 1M: -20.53%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.76% | 1M: -7.23%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR divergence as several large-cap Tech show short-term bounces but 1M weakness.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed/rotational with short-term bounces across Mega-Cap Tech: AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +5.50% | 1M: -9.16%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.42% | 1M: -1.82%) RECOVERY, but semiconductor names remain weak: INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND; Technology 1W: +1.30% (24 stocks) — internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Healthy and broad: JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.09% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND — Financials 1W: +4.14% (20 stocks) showing leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive support but mixed: JNJ (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.80%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: +1.75% (17 stocks) — steady but not dominant.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials and selective cyclicals (JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak semiconductors and lagging discretionary names (INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech top performers and broad Financial strength.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY for follow-through on chip-deal headlines; SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND for earnings/flows. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -20.17% | 1M: +10.52%) CORRECTION for semiconductor cycle risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth strong, 1W: +4.14%). BEARISH: Semiconductors/Tech hardware within Technology (LRCX, AMAT, INTC under pressure).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch their trend confirmation: AAPL sustained >1W highs for a multi-day confirmation of RECOVERY; NVDA needs sustained break above recent short-term highs to negate 1M weakness; JPM holding ABOVE TREND momentum for Financial leadership continuation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
AAPL (+50): Broadcom extension headline aligns with AAPL price action (AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY) — sentiment confirming near-term accumulation. (Other notable bullish headlines include CSCO +75 and DE +75 in the feed but timeframe detail not in this snapshot.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (-45): headline-led selling aligns with price (INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND) — confirming. AMAT (-45): negative memory-cycle headlines while price is in CORRECTION (AMAT (1W: -20.17% | 1M: +10.52%) CORRECTION) — watch for trend exhaustion. LRCX (-45): news and price both negative (LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND). CAT (-45): industrial weakness confirmed (CAT (1W: -9.01% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Style: mixed / no clear leadership.  
Strength in Financials and select cyclicals: SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META showing 1W strength but 1M weakness) and negative sentiment in semiconductors (INTC, AMAT, LRCX) — watch for trend breaks and treat moves as tactical opportunities, not core confirmations.
